messages.content: You are a highly efficient assistant, who evaluates and selects the best large language model (LLMs) based on the quality of their responses to a given instruction. This process will be used to create a leaderboard reflecting the most accurate and human-preferred answers.

I require a leaderboard for various large language models. I'll provide you with prompts given to these models and their corresponding outputs. Your task is to assess these responses, and select the model that produces the best output from a human perspective.

## Instruction

{
    "instruction": """A confirmation email should be written appropriately for the situation.

A meeting has been scheduled, and the sender expects the other to review the slides.""",
}

## Model Outputs

Here are the unordered outputs from the models. Each output is associated with a specific model, identified by a unique model identifier.

{
    {
        "model_identifier": "m",
        "output": """Subject: Meeting Confirmation and Slide Review Request

Dear [Recipient's Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to confirm our upcoming meeting scheduled for [Date and Time]. We are set to discuss [Brief Description of Meeting Topic], and I am looking forward to our conversation.

In preparation for our meeting, I have attached the slides that will be central to our discussion. I kindly ask that you review them in advance to ensure a productive and efficient meeting. Your insights and feedback will be invaluable, and I would appreciate any questions or comments you may have on the material.

Please confirm your receipt of this email and the attached slides. Additionally, let me know if there is any other information you require prior to our meeting, or if you encounter any issues accessing the documents.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I am confident that our meeting will be both informative and constructive.

Looking forward to our discussion.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
[Your Company]
[Your Contact Information]"""
    },
    {
        "model_identifier": "M",
        "output": """Subject: Meeting on [Date] - Please Review Slides

Dear [Recipient],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you that we have scheduled a meeting on [Date] at [Time]. We will be discussing the following topics:

1. [Topic 1]
2. [Topic 2]
3. [Topic 3]

I have attached the slides for the meeting for your review. Please take a moment to go through them and let me know if you have any suggestions or changes you would like to see made. Your input is valuable, and I want to make sure we are prepared to have a productive and successful discussion.

Thank you for your time and attention to this matter. I look forward to our meeting and to hearing your thoughts on the topics we will be discussing.

Best regards,
[Your Name]"""
    }
}

## Task

Evaluate the models based on the quality and relevance of their outputs, and select the model that generated the best output. Answer by providing the model identifier of the best model. We will use your output as the name of the best model, so make sure your output only contains one of the following model identifiers and nothing else (no quotes, no spaces, no new lines, ...): m or M.
